title: Automating Static Code Analysis Through CI/CD Pipeline Integration
abstract: arXiv:2609.00676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the contemporary landscape of software devel-opment, securing sensitive data is paramount to safeguarding organizational reputation, preventing financial losses, and pro-tecting individuals from identity theft. This paper addresses the pervasive challenge of identifying and rectifying security vulnerabilities early in the development process, emphasizing the role of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools. While SAST tools play a crucial role in detecting vulnerabilities, widespread adoption has been hindered by usability issues, including high false positive rates and a lack of native pipeline support. This paper proposes a novel, generalized, and automated process for aggregating SAST tool outputs and integrating them into developers' familiar issue-tracking software. translated_title: 通过CI/CD流水线集成实现静态代码分析自动化
translated_abstract: 在当今的软件开发环境中，保护敏感数据的安全至关重要，这关系到维护组织声誉、防止经济损失以及保护个人免受身份盗窃的侵害。本文着重解决在开发过程中尽早识别和修复安全漏洞这一普遍存在的挑战，并强调了静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具的作用。尽管SAST工具在检测漏洞方面发挥着关键作用，但其广泛应用一直受到可用性问题的阻碍，包括较高的误报率以及缺乏对流水线的原生支持。本文提出了一种新颖的、通用的、自动化的流程，用于聚合SAST工具的输出结果，并将其集成到开发人员熟悉的问题跟踪软件中。该流程简化了开发生命周期中安全漏洞的识别与沟通，从而促进了更高效的漏洞修复。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖且通用的自动化流程，通过CI/CD流水线集成将SAST工具的输出聚合并整合到开发人员熟悉的问题跟踪软件中，从而简化安全漏洞的识别与修复过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel, generalized, and automated process that aggregates SAST tool outputs and integrates them into developers' familiar issue-tracking software through CI/CD pipeline integration, streamlining the identification and remediation of security vulnerabilities during the development lifecycle.
